notes.title: Usual June DEV UPDATE
notes.content:
We've got more ghosts, more mysteries, and horrifying new boss monsters getting ready to infest this unsuspecting college town. We're staying very busy creating new environments, using our new animation tools to beef up our NPCs, and diving deep into the weird realities and urban legends of midwestern cities. We all know truth is stranger than fiction, but it's extra strange in the flyover states. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781304/88132302366d6c76ed8d66ad4feef4f3e7a76394.gif"]

Above you can see our Animator Mike showing off Sunny's expressions! With this rig and our new animation tools, she can respond to every situation her adventure might throw at her. What do you think she's saying in that gif? 



We sent this update in our newsletter last week! Sign up for it today if you're interested in getting monthly (most of the time) news on this and our other award-winning games!

notes.title: AHHH! USUAL JUNE IS IN THE STEAM SCREAM FEST!
notes.content:
AHHHHHHH! This game is full of g-g-ghosts!??! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781304/2fee994229cefd38837d81210dfecdfaecc00292.gif

The one in the Usual June demo isn't too scary though, don't worry! Go on, play it and find out for yourself! 

The demo is available NOW through November 2! 

If you find yourself screaming, it might be from how much fun you're having and how beautiful the art is! 

Wishlist Usual June for more updates on development, and don't forget to follow us on socials! 

You can follow us on the Finji page for updates about our other games too!

notes.title: Usual June 👻 Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
This Halloween season, you can catch us talking to ghosts in the Usual June demo! Specifically, one little weird, but sweet, ghost boy named Teddy! 

You can play the Usual June demo now through October 21st!

Go fight some glowy crab things, investigate the dark secrets of Fen Harbor, and get to know June, Sunny, and Teddy! Don't forget to wishlist the game for updates throughout its development and come hang out with us in the Finji discord! 

💀 Brand New Usual June Pins! 💀

Make no bones about it, you're going to look very fun with this pin on a jacket! We premiered our brand new Usual June skull pins at PAX West last month, but you can grab one online right now at shop.finji.co! 
While you're over there, you can also grab the stylish official Usual June t-shirt! Both items glow-in-the-dark, so your friends won't lose you in any dark and dusty observatories.

notes.title: Designing Combat - Usual June Devlog #1
notes.content:
We're so excited to show you our first devlog for Usual June! 

In this one, our Community & Social Media Manager Aster spoke with Finji Creative Director Adam Saltsman, Usual June VFX Artist Eduardo Noé, and Animator Mike Kersey about the some of the thought process and work that goes into creating "crabs" and helping June fight them! 

Check it out now!

[previewyoutube=9mb4kLgeTzY;full][/previewyoutube]

See it in action by playing the Usual June demo now! 

Let us know if there's another subject you'd like to hear the devs talk about! 

If you want to keep seeing updates on the game's development, throw Usual June on your wishlist and maybe give us a follow on socials!
